name: octaweave_list_calendars
description: List the workspace's calendars ({id, name, slug, color, timezone}). Needed to target a specific calendar when creating an event; omit `calendar` there to use the default one.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
